easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
